lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters of varying diameters are distributed across the lateral flank. The highest intensity maxima are concentrated in the mid-flank region posterior to the gill slits, forming a non-linear 2D spatial arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible across the flank, intersecting with the circular blobs to create a semi-regular grid of high-intensity nodes, most prominent in the anterior-midsection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features run horizontally across the upper dorsal-lateral region, characterized by sharp vertical pixel intensity gradients with high-luminance superior edges and shadowed inferior edges.
